Luanshi contributors fitted folded sprays from the original tree to the seven main limbs and inner forks of the game's existing riverbank trunk, adapted wind and crown normals, and filtered the diffuse and cutout atlas for field use. The original and the derived ford_willow.glb and ford_willow.png are distributed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported.
